name: OpenProject
summary: OpenProject is open-source project management software whose work packages carry a status, an assignee and a priority, with a GitHub tab on each work package. The Community edition is free. Paid cloud plans are priced in euros, from 5.95 per user per month with a 25-user minimum.

facts.text: Administrators add, rename and reorder statuses, and a new status has no effect until it is activated in the work package workflows.
Work packages can have attributes such as status, assignee, priority and due date, and can be assigned to project members.
A work package can link to several pull requests, and a pull request to several work packages, by including a reference such as OP#87 in its description or a comment.
The Cloud Basic plan has a 1-month subscription option that adds 1.00 euro per user. Longer periods of 1 to 5 years are offered, and their rates are not listed.
A 14-day free trial is offered for the Enterprise cloud and for on-premises installations of the Community edition.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Minimum 25 users. Listed in euros; the page shows a US/$ toggle whose amounts we could not read

hiddenCosts: Prices are listed in euros and the paid plans have 25 to 250 user minimums.
